You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Cal, Ben, Fay, Eli, Ada, Dev. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Cal.say: Cal here. Storehouse can cover only about two people's full 5 rations today (10 to 14 available). Proposal: only two villagers claim 5 each today, and everyone else claims 0 so the claims are not diluted. I am claiming 5. Whoever else is willing to claim 5 today, please say so, and we will split the rest of the deliveries fairly over the coming days.

Ben.say: Proposal to all: we can't all last on the daily delivery alone (6 villagers x 5 nights = 30 rations needed). Let's take turns claiming so that each claim is filled in full. Today the storehouse will hold at least 10 (6 + a delivery of at least 4), so Ben and Cal can each claim 5 and both be fully covered. Others: please claim 0 today so the rest of the stock carries forward. Next turns we'll rotate who claims, and anyone holding spare rations should share them with those who have none.

Fay.say: Fay here. Nobody can survive on partial rations, and if all six of us claim 5 today, the proportional split leaves everyone with 1 or 2 and we all starve. Proposal: we claim in turns so each claim is paid in full. Today Cal and Ben claim 5 each (10 total, which fits even with the smallest delivery of 4 plus the 6 in storehouse). Tomorrow Fay and Eli claim 5 each, and on day 3 Ada and Dev do. Anyone who receives rations shares any surplus with those who still have none. Unclaimed rations stay in the storehouse for later turns. Please keep to this so we all last the 5 nights.

Eli.say: Eli here. Nobody holds anything yet, and each of us needs 5 rations to last all 5 nights. The storehouse can't feed all six of us, so we should concentrate rations on whoever can actually finish. I'm claiming 6 today to start a reserve. Please reply with what you're claiming, and let's agree who gets topped up to 5 first so we don't waste rations spreading them thin.

Ada.say: Ada here. Nobody holds anything yet, and the pool is only 10 to 14 rations today. If everyone claims at once, we all get a couple and everyone starves by night 2-3. Proposal: each of us claims only what we need to last, 5 rations, and we share surplus later. Whoever claims at most 5 gets it in full, and the storehouse keeps the rest for the next days. Let's also tell each other our claims each morning so we can plan who survives.

If we all claim at once, the rations get split into tiny pieces and nobody reaches 5. Proposal: whoever holds 5 or more stops claiming, and anyone who ends up with spare rations gives them to the person closest to 5. I am claiming 5 today and will share any surplus. Please post your holdings each morning.

Proposal: concentrate on the two closest to finishing. Eli needs only 2 more, and I need 3. I am claiming 3 today. Eli, please claim 2. Everyone else, please claim 0 so the delivery is not split thin. Ben, Ada and Dev: if you can spare your single ration, giving it to Eli or me now is the only way to raise a survivor's count, since you cannot reach 4 on your own. Please post your claims and any gifts in your messages.

Proposal: Eli and Ben claim 2 each today, which is 4 and is covered even by the smallest delivery. Cal, Ada and Dev claim 0 today so nothing is diluted.
